layout.house_prompt: A boutique hotel suite with a bedroom, a living area, a walk-in closet, a dressing room, and a bathroom. The bedroom has a king-size bed with two nightstands. The living area has a sofa and a coffee table. The walk-in closet has a wardrobe and a luggage rack. The dressing room has a vanity with a mirror. The bathroom has a toilet, a sink, and a bathtub.

living_room.text_description: A modern boutique hotel suite living area with an elegant sofa and a coffee table, warm ambient lighting, and refined finishes.

bedroom.text_description: A modern boutique hotel suite bedroom featuring a king-size bed with two nightstands, plush textiles, and calm upscale decor.

dressing_room.text_description: A modern boutique hotel suite dressing room with a vanity and mirror, bright task lighting, and streamlined built-in storage.

walk_in_closet.text_description: A modern boutique hotel suite walk-in closet with a wardrobe system and a luggage rack, organized shelving, and soft lighting.

bathroom.text_description: A modern boutique hotel suite bathroom with a toilet, a sink, and a bathtub, spa-like finishes, and privacy-focused lighting.
